clips.title: The story
paras: In Stormwind Keep, Milton Sheaf guards the kingdom's written history. He tends the Royal Library and calls on Alliance travelers to recover lost books and records.

Milton Sheaf tends the Royal Library inside Stormwind Keep. While the court handles politics, noble disputes, and military concerns, he preserves the written record. He sees accurate histories of the Alliance and the Eastern Kingdoms as a duty, especially amid war, loss, and instability.

Milton Sheaf sends travelers to recover books scattered across the realm. Volumes wear with use, while records lie in monastic archives, distant outposts, and forgotten ruins. He sends Alliance adventurers from Northshire Abbey to Southshore in the north to retrieve misplaced books, examine ancient texts, and return rare manuscripts safely to the keep.
